title: [Decision] E4 of #27293 — official connector apps: which are open edition (this repository) and which commercial (cloud repository), and when the first shelf starts
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Ruled: 6486157794 · letter A (phased) · 2026-10-29T02:27Z
Blocked-by: #26709
Blocked-by: #27237

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can take, on ③ the maintainer's direct instruction in `session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U`, 2026-10-28, verbatim, in order: 「连接器先不考虑」 · 「连接器立决策卡」 · 「连接器分开源版和商业版，商业版在 cloud 仓库。」 Sub-issue of #27293 (E4 row). ⛔ Not a claim; nothing in E4 is dispatched while this card is open.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不改代码。#27293 的 E4「首批 20–30 个官方连接器应用」从待立卡改为待裁。已定：连接器分开源版与商业版，商业版在 cloud 仓。待裁：哪些应用算开源版、哪些算商业版（按什么划线），以及何时开工。
- 为什么改：你说「连接器先不考虑」；划线规则没有定过 —— 现有的开源/企业线（ADR-0097，经 ADR-0143 修订）只管平台能力，不管上架的应用归哪一版。
- 风险与回滚：卡挂着期间 E1–E3 照常推进，E4 不动；裁决可随时改。
- 先看：「选项」表与「推荐」。注意：按 ADR-0143 的现行能力线，清单上 20–30 个应用的认证方式（静态密钥 / OAuth2 / 签名）全部属于开源层。
- 两分钟验证：`git show origin/main:docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md | sed -n 125,145p`。
- 需要你做的：选 A / B / C（或带条件）。

## Background

#27293's E4 row asks the epic PM to file 20–30 official connector apps as metadata packages (normalized spec + `include` + listing + README credentials section): a static-key batch (Stripe read, GitHub, Twilio, Okta, Adyen, OpenAI, monday, Neon) after E1 #26709 and E2 #27237; an OAuth batch (Microsoft Graph, Notion, Atlassian, Google) after #26702; a signature batch (Alipay v3) after #26710; DocuSign as the first declarative verification of the OAuth path. The parent assigns ingestion and listing generation to the cloud repository.

**Settled by the maintainer (verbatim above):** connectors come in an open edition and a commercial edition; the commercial edition lives in the cloud repository.

**Governing text:** `docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` §"Open / enterprise line (ADR-0015)", as amended by ADR-0143 (2026-10-27): open source = the `rest` / `openapi` / `mcp` provider factories, static auth, env-resolved `credentialRef`, and now `oauth2` / `app-credential` / `signed` with the connection record and Connect / Reconnect flow; enterprise keeps the vault-backed `CredentialResolver` backend and per-tenant connection lifecycle. That line is about platform **capabilities**; no text says which **listed app** belongs to which edition. Searched: `git grep -n -iE "official (app|package|connector)|first-party (app|package|listing)" origin/main -- docs/adr docs/NORTH-STAR.md packages/spec/src/marketplace` → 1 hit (ADR-0141:310, a dependency table row, not this); `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` for `official|first-party|repo|source|seed|curat` → none.

**Protocol statement:** nothing an author can write changes here; every option consumes E1–E3's keys as they land.

## Premises (each with its re-check)

1. No package home for official connector apps exists in this repository. Re-check: `git ls-tree --name-only origin/main packages/apps/` → 3 entries (`account`, `setup`, `studio`), all platform apps (read 2026-10-28T15:39Z).
2. Every auth kind the named apps need is open tier after ADR-0143. Re-check: the `sed -n 125,145p` read above (static: Stripe…Neon; `oauth2`: Microsoft Graph, Notion, Atlassian, Google, DocuSign; `signed`: Alipay v3).
3. Every E4 batch is gated on an open card: #26709 open (items 1, 3(c), 4 remain), #27237 open (in flight, `domain:server` seat 3), #26702 and #26710 open and `pm:blocked` on #26768. Re-check: `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/N --jq .state` for each.
4. No named customer has asked for a specific connector app on the board. Re-check: the dedupe below.

## The question

When the marketplace gets official connector apps, which of them does a self-hosting open-source user get from this repository, and which come only with the commercial edition from the cloud repository — and does the work start now or after E1 + E2?

## Options

| | What it does | What a customer sees | Effort |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | The edition follows the ADR-0097/0143 capability line: an app whose every key runs on the open tier is open edition and lives in this repository (private, validated by this repo's CI against the runtime at HEAD); an app that needs an enterprise capability (vault backend, per-tenant connection lifecycle) or a commercial-only provider is commercial edition in the cloud repository. On today's list that puts all 20–30 in the open edition. Start after E1 + E2. | Open-source users get the whole first shelf; the commercial edition adds the apps that need its capabilities, plus hosting. | `domain:devx` ~3 PRs (one per batch) + 1 cloud pipeline card; no precedent |
| **B** | The edition is a business choice per listing: this repository ships only a small open reference set (DocuSign + 2–3 static-key apps, the ones #27293's Done-when needs); the rest of the shelf is commercial edition in the cloud repository even though it runs on the open tier. Start after E1 + E2. | Open-source users get a few samples and the E3 recipes to build the rest; the full shelf is a commercial feature. | `domain:devx` 1 PR + `repo:cloud` ~3 PRs; no precedent |
| **C** | Every official connector app is commercial edition in the cloud repository; the open edition ships the providers and E3's recipes only. Start after E1 + E2. | Open-source users build their own from the recipes; no official apps outside the commercial edition. | `repo:cloud` ~3 PRs; no precedent |

Business meaning: A is "the edition is decided by what the engine can do, so one rule sorts every app"; B is "a few free samples, the catalogue is the paid product"; C is "the catalogue is entirely the paid product".

## 四维分析

<!-- os-decision-facets -->
os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性：两年后的样子是「开源版与商业版的边界只有一条，且写在 ADR 里」；A 复用 ADR-0143 已裁的能力线，新应用按其所需能力机械归版，不新增第二份手工名单；B、C 是逐个应用的商业判断，需要一份长期维护的归属清单，边界随清单漂移。
- ② 实际业务拉动：板上无具名客户点名要某个连接器（检索见下）；拉动来自 #27293 的 Done-when 与北极星第④步。零客户拉动 ⇒ 三个选项都先停到 E1/E2 落地；商业版靠目录收费有多大拉动，席位测不到，只有你知道。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错：A 的归版判据可机械判定（应用用到的认证种类是否全在开源枚举内），写应用的 agent 放错仓会被检查出来；B、C 靠名单，放错仓不会有任何报错（静默）。开源仓内的应用还能在同一 CI 里过 `os validate`，契约变化当场响亮失败。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散：每个上架应用都是永久维护义务（厂商 API 漂移、来源 sha256、许可证复核）；B 让开源仓只背 3–4 个，最省；A 让开源仓背全部 20–30 个；C 让开源仓零负担但维护全落到 cloud。
Prior rulings read: connector app,shelf,official listing,marketplace seed → 0 hits; ADR-0097 §Open/enterprise line amended by ADR-0143 (capabilities, not listings); thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**A**, phased: park now; when E1 + E2 land, start with only the apps #27293's Done-when needs (DocuSign for the OAuth path plus two or three static-key apps), and grow toward 20–30 on customer pull. Not B: it adds a second, hand-kept edition boundary next to the ADR one, and a misplaced app fails nowhere. Not C: it leaves the open edition's marketplace with no reference the E3 recipes can point at. Confidence gap: the commercial edition's revenue model is not on the board; if its value is meant to be the curated catalogue itself, B is the shape that serves it. Also unverified: whether hosted runtimes ship the `openapi` / `mcp` / `rest` providers by default (#27293 Risks).

Self-check: 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否（②④ 只把时序推到 E1/E2 之后并分期；④ 偏 B 但不翻字母）。

## After the ruling

- A or B: this card → `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #26709` and `Blocked-by: #27237`; when both close, the epic PM files one card per batch (static-key; OAuth after #26702; signature after #26710) as sub-issues of #27293 in the edition's repository, plus the cloud pipeline card in the cloud repository.
- C: the cloud repository's seat owns E4; this card closes with a carrier card filed there; #27293's E4 row and its Done-when "E4 lists at least 20 connector apps" are rewritten to point at it.
